purpose: This module runs a fixed, hard-coded measurement of the badminton court annotator: four video cases crossed with two court-detection methods (static homography vs detected CourtKeyNet consensus), producing eight configurations. It verifies pinned input files, runs inference and scene/court evidence extraction for each configuration, scores results against ground truth, and writes structured JSON/CSV manifests, metrics, and failure records for each stage, plus a final run-level manifest.

public_api.name: FixedCase
public_api.role: Frozen dataclass describing one fixed video/track case (case_id, fixture name, tracknet stride/mode, fps, frame count); instantiated for the four CASES.

public_api.name: InputManifest
public_api.role: Frozen dataclass holding the parsed strict input manifest (video/track/config/weights pins plus producer labels); returned by parse_input_manifest.

public_api.name: CaseData
public_api.role: Mutable dataclass holding loaded arrays (track/bboxes/scores/kps/ndet), pins, raw cuts, and status for one case; built by an internal loader and consumed when running configurations.

public_api.name: ConfigurationState
public_api.role: Mutable dataclass tracking the terminal state of one parent/case configuration run (result, court evidence, capture, status, manifest path).

public_api.name: RunDriver
public_api.role: Mutable dataclass holding overall run state (device, manifest, detector, cases, configurations, failure paths); threaded through setup/run/score/manifest steps.

public_api.name: VideoMetadata
public_api.role: NamedTuple of fps/n_frames/width/height returned by probe_video for validating a pinned video file.

public_api.name: utc_now
public_api.role: Returns the current UTC time as an RFC 3339 string; used for timestamping manifests and logs.

public_api.name: parse_input_manifest
public_api.role: Parses and strictly validates a JSON input manifest (bytes/str/dict) into an InputManifest; call before running a measurement.

public_api.name: verify_selected_pins
public_api.role: Verifies a given list of FilePin objects (path safety and hash) without loading a fixture's whole file bundle; used when only specific pins are needed.

public_api.name: probe_video
public_api.role: Opens a video with OpenCV and reads fps/frame count/width/height without running inference; used to sanity-check a pinned video before use.

public_api.name: validate_video_metadata
public_api.role: Raises ValueError if a probed video's metadata does not match the fixed case's expected fps, frame count, or dimensions.

public_api.name: verify_eligible_gt_files
public_api.role: Verifies that each fixture's ground-truth CSV directory contains exactly the expected pinned files and that their hashes match, at the scoring boundary.

public_api.name: run_annotator_measurement
public_api.role: Top-level entry point: given a manifest path and an output root, runs the full fixed eight-configuration measurement, writing all artefacts, and returns a process exit code; called by the CLI or tests with a chosen output directory.

public_api.name: build_parser
public_api.role: Builds the argparse.ArgumentParser for the CLI (--manifest, --device flags).

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: CLI entry point: parses args, resolves an output directory automatically, runs the measurement, writes a summary/report, and cleans the run; used when the module is run as a script.
